The latest quotation revision for our EAGLE-VA-TURRET (A2055) machine is revision 3, which has been approved. This revision includes a guard interlock safety retrofit on both turrets with an 8% discount applied, totaling 30,452 EUR. Additionally, there was a pressure cap head refurbishment and NSF-H1 lubrication service for Bottling Hall B, revised to version 2 with a 4% discount applied, amounting to 15,091.20 EUR.

The most recent quotation revision for the EAGLE VA turret 24000 h general overhaul in Bottling Hall A was rejected due to budget constraints, and it has been at a final offer of 10% discount since its validity date on May 30, 2025.
